metadata.clan_summary:
[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC bob-cli-fv[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Google Calendar descriptions become Event Task bullets[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]`bob gcal sync` writes the human part of each Google Calendar event[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]description as sanitized, capped, flat bullets directly under the [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]Event Task it creates. Directive lines and video-call boilerplate [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]are left out. The bullets follow Google until Bryan edits them, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]they can never trigger Bob, Dataview, or Tasks behavior, and they [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]read cleanly in Source mode, Live Preview, and Reading view.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]8[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]5[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]plan:202611/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]gcal_description_bullets.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim] Prompt: [#87AFFF][/dim]prompts/202611/gcal_description_bullets.md[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Bead: [#87AFFF][/dim]bob-cli-fv[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Page: [#87AFFF][/dim]https://github.com/bobs-org/bob-cli--beads/blob/main/pages/bob-cli-fv/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]README.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Inert note-text escaper[/bold #D7AFFF]                                       [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]note-escaper[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]note-escaper: lift gkeep's escape_child_text into task_text_escape.rs [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]unchanged and add escape_note_text / escape_note_inline, which make [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]imported prose inert.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]CANCEL LOG indentation matches the plugin writer[/bold #D7AFFF]              [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]cancel-log-indent[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]cancel-log-indent: make the gcal CANCEL LOG writer reuse the task's [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]existing child indentation (else TAB) so a later CANCEL LOG nests [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]correctly above tab-indented description bullets.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Structured description parser[/bold #D7AFFF]                                 [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]description-parser[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]description-parser: one linear HTML/plain-text parse into structured [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]lines that feeds both directive verdicts (shared vectors stay [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]byte-identical) and the future bullets. GcalEvent carries the result [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]behind a redacted Debug.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Separator, badge-duplicate, and vendor boilerplate filter[/bold #D7AFFF]     [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]boilerplate-filter[dim] · [dim][/dim]after description-parser[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]boilerplate-filter: drop separators, lines that only repeat the 📹 or 📍[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]target, and fenced or header-anchored Meet, Zoom, Teams, and Webex [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]blocks. Keep a join link only when the row has no 📹 badge.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Bullet renderer, guards, and scanner-isolation gate[/bold #D7AFFF]           [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]bullet-renderer[dim] · [dim][/dim]after note-escaper, description-parser[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]bullet-renderer: turn parsed lines into sanitized, capped bullet bodies [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]with tidy links, drawer and managed-log guards, an overflow line, an [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]oversize fallback, and a stable hash. A differential test against Bob's [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]real scanners proves the output is inert.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Bullets on created and upgraded Event Tasks[/bold #D7AFFF]                   [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]birth-bullets[dim] · [dim][/dim]after boilerplate-filter, bullet-renderer[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]birth-bullets: add the config keys, write the bullets with every created[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Event Task and Maybe→Yes upgrade, add the tri-state journal description [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]record carried by every row record, match rows only on top-level lines, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]add ≡ N and description_lines, and document birth-time behavior.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  7 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Description bullets follow Google until edited[/bold #D7AFFF]                [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]live-bullets[dim] · [dim][/dim]after birth-bullets, cancel-log-indent[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]live-bullets: locate the journaled block, rewrite or remove it while [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]untouched, keep Bryan's edits with one kept_description notice, backfill[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]rows synced before the feature, match crash adoptions, and update the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]ownership contract docs.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  8 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Decision record and end-to-end review[/bold #D7AFFF]                         [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]decision-and-review[dim] · [dim][/dim]after live-bullets[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]decision-and-review: author the new decision record and the supersession[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]mark, regenerate docs, run the full gates, and do a read-only end-to-end[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]review against the A1–A10 requirements.[/#D7D7AF]
